notes.text: The page continues an argument about two decompositions of X, records their five-term intersection partition and a definition of Sigma12, and writes three closure relations followed by two nonempty-intersection assertions. The final prose and bracketed equality are transcribed as the page writes them.
No explicit authorial question mark or verbal statement of doubt was observed. The unsure qualifications in reading.tex are this reader’s apparatus; they do not supply words to the manuscript.
No title, date or authorial page number is visible. The lower-left archive numeral is 15 and is retained only in a comment. The supplied metadata maps scan 16 to H page 15.

No topological theorem, algebraic computation, inferred correspondence or intended conclusion was used to repair or choose the transcription. check_events is empty. The signs, bars, terms, indices and two bracket returns were assessed from their ink.

H’s explanatory brace notes describe the two central braces and the lower annotation; they are treated as apparatus, with their manuscript labels collated. They supply no additional prose to be transcribed. H uses sqcup for the ordinary square joins; that macro convention alone is not counted as a reading difference. The amended bottom joins are each collated locally.

C_notes.txt contains one blank newline. Only the 13 actual Doubtful readings rows in C_doubts.txt are counted as source doubt rows; notation and abbreviation rows supply context only. The compound rows 04, 07, 10 and 12 are expanded into explicit local status entries.

The top-right insertion, the opening-right rule, the final bracket and the lower underbrace label reach original image boundaries. All crops include the complete available source extent; missing material beyond those original boundaries is not supplied. Crop 17 is a tight margin-only crop; its neighbouring text position was established in the one half-b view.

Every newly retained path is named in reading.tex and in the differences/inventory. Fixed local origins, base-west anchors, zero node padding and x/y units are declared. The source-coordinate rectangles describe the path placement; they do not assert exact font extents. No compilation or rendered layout validation was performed.

BR01 and BR02 redraw the visible central brace runs with their existing Sigma2-minus and Sigma1-minus labels. G04 is the separate point beside them. The brace path changes and the point are recorded separately; no physical stroke is drawn twice.
